description: This file provides type definitions for utility functions related to ESLint context handling, including functions to retrieve filenames, source code, scope, ancestors, and declared variables within ESLint rules.

methods.name: declare function getAncestors(context: Context, node: ESTree.Node): ESTree.Node[]; getAncestors
methods.description: Retrieves the ancestor nodes of a given AST node within a specific ESLint context.

methods.name: getDeclaredVariables
methods.description: Obtains the variables declared at a specific node within a given context.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the ESLint context.

methods.name: getPhysicalFilename
methods.description: Returns the physical filename, if available, associated with the ESLint context.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Retrieves the scope information for a specific node in the given context.

methods.name: getSourceCode
methods.description: Returns the source code object linked with the ESLint context.

ctags.name: getAncestors
ctags.pattern: /^declare function getAncestors(context: Context, node: ESTree.Node): ESTree.Node[];$/
